newsitem.title: SPAIN: Metrovacesa sees clear property recovery.
newsitem.headline: Metrovacesa sees clear property recovery.

text.p: Spanish property firm Metrovacesa forecasts a clear recovery in its sector, chairman Jose Antonio Saenz-Azcunaga said on Friday.
"Important real estate products such as offices, industrial parks and shopping centres will in the near future accentuate their current recovery," he told the shareholders' meeting.
Net investment of 11.6 billion pesetas in 1996 will be topped up with similar amounts for each of the next four years, he added.
Prices of property for sale are "roughly at the same levels as in previous years, with high activity rates which will be maintained in future years," he said.
Rental prices were not problematic either, he added, with small falls in prices of large apartments only.
